title: Quotient construction auxiliary
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_aux {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) : ∃ (K : CoherentFormalModule X I) (ι : K ⟶ F) (e : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≅ K.obj.obj (op n)), (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 2) (S.obj (op (n + 1 + c))) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = S.map (homOfLE (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) c)).op ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom ≫ ι.hom.app (op n) = j.app (op (n + c)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n c)).op) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, kernel.ι (ι.hom.app (op (n + c))) ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n c)).op = 0)

proof.text: Use the stabilized image equality together with the affine formal-module equivalence and Artin--Rees calculation to construct the quotient system and prove eventual kernel vanishing.
